annotation.title_clean: Latin America and the Caribbean Accelerate the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence, though Challenges Remain in Investment, Talent, and Governance
annotation.title_en: Latin America and the Caribbean Accelerate the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence, though Challenges Remain in Investment, Talent, and Governance
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ECLAC (UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean)
annotation.summary_en: ECLAC press release presenting the third Latin American AI Index (ILIA 2025) with CENIA Chile, measuring AI readiness, adoption and governance in 19 countries. It finds accelerating adoption but gaps in investment, talent and governance, and weak national strategy implementation. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: ILIA 2025 covers 19 countries across enabling factors, R&D/adoption, and governance.
Chile, Brazil and Uruguay are pioneers; over one-third of countries are explorers.
Region receives only 1.12% of global AI investment despite 6.6% of global GDP.
National AI strategies often lack financing, implementation mechanisms and impact evaluation.
Calls for regional cooperation and aligning digital and productive development policies.
